slides.texte_overlay:
θ९ small habits that make you smarter
and give you an advantage at school at the same time

1. one question per class
you listen differently when you're looking for something to ask.

2. explain your day's lesson out loud on the way home
if you can't, you know what to review.

3. test yourself on the week's lessons every sunday
15 minutes. by exam time, it's all already there.

4. a documentary instead of scrolling
same screen time. you actually learn something.

5. link every lesson to something real
a formula, a date, a word: where do you see it in real life?

6. homework the same day it's given
it's easier while the lesson is still fresh.
